title: Group Product Manager, Supply Chain Planning
posting_text:
Quillstone builds planning software for consumer-goods supply chains.

What you'll do
- Lead a team of four product managers
- Own the planning suite's strategy

What we're looking for
- 10+ years of product management, 3+ managing product managers
- Supply-chain planning experience
